eps.ov: Numerous golems emerge in the city. Amidst the chaos, a swordsman, Soujirou Yagyuu, appears.
eps.oa: تظهر غولمات كثيرة في المدينة، ووسط الفوضى يظهر مبارز: «سوجيرو ياغيو».

eps.ov: A spy comes under attack, and a certain military officer attempts to slay a dragon.
eps.oa: يتعرض جاسوس للهجوم، ويحاول ضابط عسكري بعينه أن يقتل تنيناً.

eps.t: Dakai the Magpie and Regnejee the Wings of Sunset
eps.ov: Dakai the Magpie searches for a traitor, while Regnejee searches for a rule-breaker.
eps.oa: يبحث «داكاي العقعق» عن خائن، بينما يبحث «ريغنيجي» عن خارق للقواعد.

eps.t: Nihilo the Vortical Stampede and Kia the World Word
eps.ov: Hidow the Clamp releases a notorious figure, and Elea the Red Tag infiltrates an elf village.

eps.t: Higuare the Pelagic and Nastique the Quiet Singer
eps.ov: Higuare the Pelagic and Shalk the Sound Slicer meet with Taren the Guarded.
Soujirou and Yuno are tasked by Hidow the Clamp with a consequential mission.
Yuno the Distant Talon and Soujirou the Willow-Sword are attacked by deadly assassins from Lithia.
Yuno the Distant Talon discovers the person responsible for a certain tragedy and vows her revenge.
Soujirou encounters a worthy opponent, while Alus the Star Runner gets surrounded by wyverns.
Elea and Kia search for Lana the Moon Tempest, and Dakai confronts Nihilo the Vortical Stampede.
Regnejee the Wings of Sunset tries to help Curte of the Fair Skies escape.
The shura head to Aureatia, each with their own motives.
